exposure: history of severe nausea and vomiting in the first trimester
history of PMS and motion sickness before pregnancy
cohort: 209 patients who underwent cesarean section under spinal-epidural combined regional anesthesia
finding: Patients who had a female neonate, history of severe nausea and vomiting in the first trimester, and history of PMS and motion sickness were at higher risk of experiencing IONV during cesarean section.
mod_finding: The study focused on predicting intraoperative nausea and vomiting in patients undergoing cesarean section under regional anesthesia.
